deploy._budget_note: Railway Pro Plan with $25/mo hard spend limit (auto-terminate). overlapSeconds is tuned to 45s (was 120s) to slash the dual-replica 4.3GiB memory burst window by >60% during deployments, keeping spend safely within the $25 monthly ceiling.
deploy._memory_note: Step-22 root cause 2026-09-06, measured: single replica idles at ~4.3GiB RSS (docker stats, compose 6Gi cap). Single replica only; Celery worker is opt-in/paused to avoid exceeding $25 budget limit.
deploy._cold_start_note: HealthcheckTimeout 330 covers worst-case sequential boot (LightRAG 120s + background init 180s = 300s, plus 30s margin). Corrected 2026-09-16 (F-PROD-1): this note previously claimed it 'matches start_railway.py _GRACE_SECONDS=330' -- the constant is and should remain 180. The two are deliberately NOT equal. _GRACE_SECONDS is the window in which healthz returns 200 unconditionally; healthcheckTimeout is how long Railway keeps retrying. Grace must stay strictly SMALLER, or every probe lands in the unconditional-200 window and no failed boot can ever fail a deploy. Between 180s and boot completion healthz correctly returns 503 ('not ready yet') and Railway retries within this 330s budget. Pinned by backend/tests/test_healthz_grace_masking.py.
